Regulatory Operations

Regulatory operations provide the operational foundation that enables compliant regulatory submissions and ongoing regulatory maintenance. Regulatory operations consulting supports organizations in managing documentation, submissions, and lifecycle activities across regions in a controlled and inspection-ready manner.

This function plays a critical role in ensuring that regulatory dossiers are accurate, complete, and traceable. Effective regulatory operations support submission planning, version control, and coordination across regulatory, clinical, and quality teams.

Well-structured regulatory operations reduce submission risk, support predictable timelines, and help organizations maintain readiness for health authority inspection.

Regulatory operations activities commonly include:

Submission planning and tracking

eCTD preparation and publishing

Regulatory document management

Lifecycle maintenance and variation support

Health authority correspondence management

As regulatory complexity increases, strong operational oversight becomes essential to maintaining compliance and execution quality.
